name: nfl-games-hub
description: NFL Games Hub - A monorepo containing multiple NFL-themed games with shared backend

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd landing-page && npm install && cd ../backend && npm install && cd ../games/nfl-teammates-game && npm install && cd ../journeyman && npm install && cd ../nfl-trivia-game && npm install
scripts.dev:teammates: npm run start:backend & npm run start:teammates
scripts.dev:journeyman: npm run start:backend & npm run start:journeyman
scripts.dev:trivia: npm run start:backend & npm run start:trivia
